title: Exolon — original Datelsoft Sharp MZ-800 artwork

source.title: Exolon New!
source.adaptationCredit: Datelsoft, identified by PRO SHARP UPRAVIL DATELSOFT in the recovered menu
source.catalogCaveat: Catalog metadata was bootstrap-imported and marked TODO verify/curate; this is an archived Datelsoft adaptation, not a verified pristine official commercial Sharp release.

recovery.headerRelocation: HL=0xd000, DE=0x0000, BC=0x9700; descending LDDR with 16-bit wrap and overlap
recovery.note: Only the original relocation/bootstrap is executed for offline extraction. The CPU interpreter, whole MZF and 64 KiB game RAM are not shipped to the browser.

bitmapEncoding.artifact: MSB-first rows after reversing each bitmap byte; drawing opcodes, coordinates and attribute bytes are not reversed

sharedModelProof.screenTileMetadata: All 125 complete tile arrays, placements, shape IDs, glyph IDs, collision, overlay and attributes equal the shared model after bitmap normalization.
sharedModelProof.spriteTables: Every byte of all nine normalized sprite/font/animation tables equals the existing ZX artifact.
sharedModelProof.pump: Complete normalized pump tiles equal shared model.
sharedModelProof.shapes: 482 of 483 source shapes are byte-identical; the exact Sharp shape 451 is preserved separately.

difference.meaning: A seven-pixel solid cell is shifted left by one source pixel. The browser retains the shared collision model while drawing the Sharp source bitmap.

highScoreRecords.format: 10 ASCII name characters and 6 decimal score characters
highScoreRecords.composition: The scores screen bitmap composition matches ZX, but the separate Datelsoft score records differ.

displayAdaptation.colors: Original sixteen-color Datelsoft mode; palette register writes F0:40,00,19,2a,3b are retained.
displayAdaptation.sourceMode: The archived Datelsoft initialization copies 0x0400 bytes from 0x6960 to 0x3000; its setup writes CE=2 and palette values 00,19,2a,3b. This archive initializes sixteen-color mode.
displayAdaptation.claim: Native sixteen-color presentation selected at user request; no four-color quantization.
displayAdaptation.loading: The platform banner uses the monochrome Sharp panel from the preserved FRGCB comparison image at user request; source author questions its loading-screen status, and association with the Datelsoft MZF is unconfirmed. No separate pre-title cover is shown. See generated dist/assets/images/intro-provenance.json for crop/hash. Extracted Datelsoft menus are preserved independently.
displayAdaptation.paletteReference: https://github.com/MZPico/mz800emu/blob/master/src/emulator/display.c (digital PAL RGB table); no emulator code is included in the game.
displayAdaptation.menuValidation: All 4617 reconstructed menu foreground pixels match the archived menu RGB capture at 2x scale, normalized to a crop origin x42,y28. The archived selected CURSOR row uses white highlighting; random stars and outer overscan are not part of this bitmap comparison.

pixelComposition.representation: One native 4-bit logical ink per pixel; no ZX PAPER/FLASH display or moving-sprite cell colour restriction.

glyphWriter.operation: GDG CC REPLACE, native INK/BRIGHT on black; ignores PAPER/FLASH

xorMasks.kind: 16x16 ordinary small sprites, high voltage and large effects; wrapper 0x334a resets mask
coloured flying enemy; erase wrappers 0x3366/0x337e use matching mask

attributeOnlyFlash.operation: Retained loop writes RAM at 0x5800 without GDG pixel writes; not displayed as ZX cell recolouring.

pixelComposition.validation: Unit tests verify four colours inside a single 8x8 cell, untouched neighbours, reversible XOR and foreground masks. Browser checks compare actual source player pixels on coloured source tiles across cell boundaries, all 125 maps and Split pairs.

rights.originalArtwork: Original commercial-game bitmap/font/sprite rights remain with their original rights holders, including Hewson/Raffaele Cecco and Datelsoft adaptation contributors. Archival availability does not establish permission or a new license.
rights.decoding: Sergey Erokhin (ESL), https://github.com/rusarh/exolon-esl, CC BY-SA 3.0; tools/recovery/world.mjs and source-derived decoding retain attribution. This does not relicense the game artwork.
rights.repository: The repository license does not replace original-game or archival-media rights.

verification.offline: Full archived MZF recovery and complete graphics extraction reproduced the recorded RAM/artifact hashes on 2026-11-20.
verification.ci: tests/unit/sharp-graphics.test.ts verifies source checksums, complete normalized table equality, the sole shape exception, maps, actual menu glyphs, Datelsoft records, malformed MZF and bit-order decoding without external source files or CPU downloads.
